attempts.summary: Created “Fleet Internal CA” on node1, trusted it system-wide on both nodes, issued node2 a server certificate for DNS node2 and IP 10.100.205.11, and configured persistent HTTPS on TCP/8443. Both nodes were rebooted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities. RHEL 10 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were preserved.
